profile.headline: Software Engineer I at Grubhub
profile.summary: Experienced Software Engineer with a demonstrated history of building and updating ETLs as well as refactoring and performing maintenance on legacy systems. Skilled in Python, Pyspark, SQL/Presto, and Git. DePaul University graduate.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Creation and maintenance of ETLs for merchant-facing data, refactoring and maintenance of legacy python financial scripts, various contributions towards Grubhub’s Universal Listing Directory flow.

positions.title: Operations Engineer
positions.description: Execution of bulk updates to the objects in salesforce and the internal GH platforms mentioned below in the Data Entry role using Bash/Command Line, from requests via Jira.

positions.title: Data Entry Specialist
positions.description: Data entry in Salesforce and various internal GH platforms to onboard new Enterprise (chain/brand) restaurants to the platform.

educations.schoolName: City Colleges of Chicago-Wilbur Wright College
